title: Tiny, cute windmill
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sky-free canvas, windmill only -->
  <!-- little hill/ground -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='38' ry='9' fill='#3fae5a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='30' ry='6' fill='#56c96e'/>
  <!-- windmill tower -->
  <polygon points='42,84 58,84 54,44 46,44' fill='#f2e6c9'/>
  <polygon points='50,84 58,84 54,44 50,44' fill='#d9c79e'/>
  <!-- little door -->
  <rect x='46' y='74' width='8' height='10' rx='4' fill='#8f5a2b'/>
  <rect x='49.5' y='74' width='4' height='10' rx='2' fill='#a86c36'/>
  <!-- tiny window -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='4' fill='#6fd6ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='2' fill='#bff0ff'/>
  <!-- roof cap -->
  <polygon points='44,44 56,44 50,34' fill='#c74b4b'/>
  <polygon points='50,44 56,44 50,34' fill='#a33535'/>
  <!-- hub -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='3.5' fill='#ffd447'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='1.6' fill='#fff6c4'/>
  <!-- blades -->
  <g fill='#ffffff' stroke='none'>
    <rect x='49' y='14' width='2.5' height='22' rx='1' fill='#eef4ff'/>
    <rect x='49' y='40' width='2.5' height='22' rx='1' fill='#eef4ff'/>
    <rect x='26' y='36.7' width='22' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#eef4ff'/>
    <rect x='52' y='36.7' width='22' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#eef4ff'/>
  </g>
  <!-- blade sails for cuteness -->
  <g fill='#9fd0ff'>
    <rect x='40' y='16' width='8' height='16' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='40' y='56' width='8' height='16' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='28' y='30' width='16' height='8' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='56' y='30' width='16' height='8' rx='1'/>
  </g>
  <!-- center cross highlight -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='1' fill='#d18700'/>
</svg>
